notablePrerequisites:
Sophina do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other nontoken creatures that can attack this turn.
An opponent is unable to block and kill creatures you control.
description:
Declare Sophina and at least tive other nontoken creatures as attackers.
Sophina triggers, creating at least six 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste or six 3/1 Dog creature tokens due to Jinnie Fay.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate Thermopod five times by sacrificing five creature tokens, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
